extracted.name: Authentic Mexican Shrimp Cocktail (Coctel de Camarones estilo Mexicano)
extracted.description: This truly authentic Mexican shrimp cocktail with plenty of spicy flavors, cucumber, jalapeno, and avocado makes a very refreshing summer appetizer.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound chilled cooked medium shrimp - peeled, deveined, and tails removed
1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped
1.5 cups chilled tomato and clam juice cocktail (such as Clamato®)
1 bunch fresh cilantro - stems discarded and leaves chopped
2 tablespoons hot pepper sauce (such as Valentina®)
instruction_lines: Mix onion with lime juice in a small bowl and allow to stand for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, toss shrimp, roma tomatoes, cucumber, celery, jalapeno, salt, and black pepper in a medium bowl until thoroughly combined.
Whisk tomato and clam juice cocktail, ketchup, cilantro, and hot pepper sauce in a separate bowl; stir dressing into shrimp mixture.
Gently fold in avocados. Stir in onion mixture. Cover and chill thoroughly, at least 1 hour.
